question: The rASRM (revised American Society for Reproductive Medicine) staging of endometriosis correlates strongly with the severity of symptoms such as pain and dyspareunia.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is false. The rASRM staging system quantifies the anatomical disease burden (implant size, adhesion extent) seen at laparoscopy. It has a well-known poor correlation with symptom severity — a key clinical pearl that guides management individualisation.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this statement is FALSE. The rASRM score is based on the extent of peritoneal and ovarian implants and adhesions seen at laparoscopy, NOT on symptom severity. A woman with Stage IV disease may have minimal pain, while a Stage I patient may have severe dysmenorrhoea.
